This is the first chapter of the [[Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master!]] manga. It was first published in the January 2021 issue of ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'', released on November 21, 2020.<ref>[http://web.archive.org/web/20230817235435/https://www.bookshop-ps.com/bsp/bsp_magcode?sha=1&sho=1385901121 ''CoroCoro Ichiban!'' January 2021 issue | Shogakukan BOOK SHOP] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[http://web.archive.org/web/20220630125129/https://corocoro.jp/news/147048/ ''CoroCoro Ichiban!'' January 2021 issue | CoroCoro Comics] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://twitter.com/kemonmon/status/1329977367150825472 Kemon Kawamoto on X (Twitter)] (Japanese)</ref> It is 16 pages long.

It was made available on CoroCoro Online on November 18, 2021 and on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on July 15, 2022.
